description.text: Introduction Short-term courses are flexible in time. Time span, level, and contents are depending on students' needs. 2 - 6 weeks courses are preferable, which may provide Chinese speaking, listening, reading, writing, and Chinese culture in addition. Admission No prerequisites for admission. Tuition Fees CNY600 / Week CNY2000 / Month

duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Language Program at Guangxi Normal University is a 6 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 83 USD/per week ￥ 600 CNY/per week

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Well behaved, healthy, and willing to abide by the Law of the People's Republic of China and the Rules and Regulations of Guangxi Normal University.
